backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the Media Share backend, defining data types and state for videos, photos, comments, likes, user profiles, ratings, and subscriptions, with access-controlled endpoints for uploading, querying, and managing media content, plus Stripe integration for premium subscriptions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two Stripe-related features (frontend checkout flow and real subscription status fetching) to their implementation files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, describing the purpose and key behavior of every component, page, and hook in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for the light and dark color themes, including background, foreground, primary, accent, chart, and sidebar tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the React SPA, setting the page title to 'Media Share', linking favicon and Apple touch icon assets, and mounting the app via the /src/main.tsx module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root TanStack Router configuration that declares all application routes (home, videos, photos, upload, player, settings, channel, upgrade, shorts, subscriptions, profile, payment-success, payment-failure) and wraps them in the shared Layout component.
frontend/src/components/AddToPlaylistMod: Empty file with no content; placeholder for an Add to Playlist modal component.
frontend/src/components/AuthButton.tsx: Thin header wrapper component that renders ProfileDropdownMenu aligned to the end, providing the authentication/profile button in the app header.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar for mobile with links to Home, Upload, Shorts, and Subscriptions, plus a Profile tab that opens the ProfileDropdownMenu instead of navigating, with active-state highlighting.
frontend/src/components/ChannelNameDispl: Component that fetches and displays a user's channel name via useChannelName hook, falling back to a truncated principal string, rendered as a router link to the channel profile page with a skeleton loading state.
frontend/src/components/CommentSection.t: Renders a comment section for a video, allowing authenticated users to post comments and displaying existing comments with author avatars, channel names, and relative timestamps.
frontend/src/components/CreatePlaylistMo: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/DeleteVideoButto: Renders a delete button that opens a confirmation AlertDialog before calling the useDeleteVideo mutation to permanently remove a video.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main app layout component providing a sticky header with search, upload, and auth controls, a collapsible sidebar, a main content area, and a footer with social links.
frontend/src/components/PhotoCard.tsx: Displays a clickable card for a photo with a placeholder image, title, uploader channel name, and upload date, navigating to the photo detail page on click.
frontend/src/components/ProfileDropdownM: Dropdown menu for user profile management supporting multi-account switching, sign-in, sign-out, and navigation to profile/settings pages.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog that prompts newly authenticated users without a profile to enter a display name and optional channel name, then saves the profile via mutation.
frontend/src/components/ShareButton.tsx: Button that copies the current page URL to the clipboard and shows a toast notification on success or failure.
frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx: Collapsible sidebar navigation with Home, Trending, and Library links, supporting a mobile overlay and smooth slide-in/out transition.
frontend/src/components/StripeSetupModal: A modal dialog for configuring Stripe payments by entering a secret key and allowed countries, using the useSetStripeConfiguration hook to save the settings.
frontend/src/components/TagInput.tsx: A tag input component that allows users to add tags via Enter or comma and remove them with an X button, managing state with badges and an inline text input.
frontend/src/components/ThumbnailSelecto: A component that auto-generates video thumbnails at multiple timestamps using a canvas, and also supports custom JPEG/PNG thumbnail uploads with validation and progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/UpgradePrompt.ts: A promotional card shown only to free-tier users that highlights premium features and navigates to the upgrade page when clicked.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: A video card component supporting default and compact display variants, showing thumbnail, title, uploader, view count, and relative upload time with navigation to the video page.
frontend/src/components/VideoEditModal.t: A tabbed modal dialog for editing a video's title, description, tags, and thumbnail, using useUpdateVideo and useRemoveThumbnail hooks to persist changes.
frontend/src/components/VideoQualitySele: A dropdown UI component for selecting video playback quality (auto, 360p–1080p) that tracks the selected option in local state without affecting actual video streaming.
frontend/src/components/VideoRating.tsx: Interactive star rating component for videos that shows the user's current rating, supports hover effects, and calls the rateVideo mutation on click. Requires authentication to submit a rating.
frontend/src/components/VideoRatingDispl: Read-only display component showing a video's average star rating with full/half/empty stars and total rating count fetched via hooks.
frontend/src/components/VideoSettings.ts: Settings card for managing a video's thumbnail, allowing the owner to view, change, or remove the current thumbnail via ThumbnailSelector and useRemoveThumbnail.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAddComment.ts: Mutation hook that calls actor.addComment and invalidates comment and video queries on success, showing toast notifications for outcomes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAverageRating.ts: Query hook that fetches the average rating for a given video ID via actor.getAverageRating.
frontend/src/hooks/useChannelName.ts: Query hook that fetches a channel's display name by principal, with a 5-minute cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useComments.ts: Query hook that fetches the list of comments for a given video ID via actor.getComments.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCheckoutSess: Mutation hook that creates a Stripe checkout session via actor.createCheckoutSession and returns the session ID and redirect URL.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteVideo.ts: Mutation hook that deletes a video by ID via actor.deleteVideo, invalidates video queries, and shows appropriate toast messages.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: Query hook that fetches the authenticated caller's user profile, with loading state tied to actor availability.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetUserRating.ts: Query hook that retrieves the current user's rating for a specific video by filtering actor.getUserRatings results.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetUserSubscriptio: Query hook that fetches the user's subscription status and maps it to a tier and feature flags object, cached for 5 minutes.
frontend/src/hooks/useIncrementVideoView: Mutation hook that increments a video's view count via actor.incrementVideoView and invalidates related video queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing Internet Computer authentication via AuthClient, exposing identity, login, clear, and status state.
frontend/src/hooks/useMarkThumbnailGener: Mutation hook that saves a generated thumbnail blob to the backend via actor.markThumbnailGenerated and invalidates video queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useMultiAccount.ts: Manages multiple Internet Identity accounts stored in localStorage, providing functions to add, remove, sign out, and update display names for accounts.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhoto.ts: React Query hook that fetches a single photo by ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhotos.ts: React Query hook that fetches the list of all photo metadata from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhotoUpload.ts: React Query mutation hook that uploads a photo file with title and description to the backend, tracking upload progress and showing toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useRateVideo.ts: React Query mutation hook that submits a star rating for a video and invalidates all related rating queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useRemoveThumbnail.ts: React Query mutation hook that removes a custom thumbnail from a video and invalidates related queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: React Query mutation hook that saves the current user's profile to the backend and invalidates profile and channel name queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSearchVideos.ts: React Query hook that searches videos by a search term and fetches full video data for each result.
frontend/src/hooks/useSetChannelName.ts: React Query mutation hook that validates and sets the caller's channel name on the backend, with appropriate error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useSetCustomThumbnail: React Query mutation hook that uploads a custom thumbnail blob for a video with progress tracking and toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useSetSubscriptionSta: React Query mutation hook that sets a user's subscription status on the backend and invalidates subscription status queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useStripeConfig.ts: Provides two hooks: one to query whether Stripe is configured and one to mutate/set the Stripe configuration on the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubscribe.ts: React Query mutation hook for subscribing to a channel; currently throws a placeholder error as the backend feature is not yet implemented.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubscriptionStatus: React Query hook that checks subscription status for a given channel principal; returns false as a placeholder until backend support is added.
frontend/src/hooks/useTotalRatings.ts: React Query hook that fetches the total number of ratings for a given video from the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateVideo.ts: React Query mutation hook that updates a video's title, description, and tags on the backend and invalidates related queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpgradeAccount.ts: React Query mutation hook for upgrading a user account to premium; currently throws a not-implemented error as a placeholder.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserStats.ts: React Query hook that fetches user statistics for a given principal from the backend, caching results for 5 minutes.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideo.ts: React Query hook that fetches extended video data for a given video ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideoLike.ts: React Query mutation hook that likes a video on the backend and invalidates related video queries with appropriate toast feedback.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideos.ts: Custom hook that fetches the full list of video metadata from the backend actor using TanStack Query, enabled only when the actor is ready.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideoUpload.ts: Custom hook that handles video file uploads to the backend actor using TanStack Query mutations, with progress tracking, typed error handling, and cache invalidation on success.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind base/components/utilities and defines CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with TanStack QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/ChannelProfile.tsx: Page component displaying a user's channel profile with their videos and photos in tabs, supporting edit and delete actions for the channel owner.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page component that fetches and displays all videos sorted by upload time in a responsive grid using VideoCard components.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Page shown after a cancelled or failed payment, offering buttons to retry the upgrade flow or return to the home page.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: Page that verifies a Stripe payment session after redirect, upgrades the user's subscription status to premium on success, and displays loading, error, or success states.
frontend/src/pages/PhotoGallery.tsx: Page that displays all photos in a searchable, debounced-filtered grid using PhotoCard components, with loading and error states.
frontend/src/pages/PhotoViewer.tsx: Displays a single photo by ID, converting the binary file data to a blob URL for rendering, along with metadata like title, uploader, and upload date.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: Shows the authenticated user's profile page with their videos and photos, including edit and delete actions for each video via a modal wrapper.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Allows authenticated users to update their display name and channel name, and shows their current subscription tier (free or premium).
frontend/src/pages/Shorts.tsx: Placeholder page indicating that short-form video support is coming soon.
frontend/src/pages/Subscriptions.tsx: Placeholder page for channel subscriptions, prompting unauthenticated users to sign in and showing a coming-soon message for authenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/Upgrade.tsx: Presents premium subscription upgrade options, initiating a Stripe checkout session or showing a Stripe setup modal if Stripe is not yet configured.
frontend/src/pages/UploadPhoto.tsx: Form page for authenticated users to upload a photo with a title, description, and file picker, showing upload progress and a success state upon completion.
frontend/src/pages/UploadVideo.tsx: Page component for uploading videos with fields for title, description, tags, and file selection, including validation, upload progress tracking, and thumbnail selection after upload.
frontend/src/pages/VideoGallery.tsx: Page component displaying a grid of all videos with debounced search functionality that switches between full listing and search results.
frontend/src/pages/VideoPlayer.tsx: Page component for playing a single video with like, subscribe, share, edit, delete, and comment features, plus view-count tracking after 5 seconds of real playback.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Utility functions to format a BigInt view count into a human-readable string (e.g., '1.2K views') and a nanosecond timestamp into a relative time string (e.g., '3 days ago').
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, border radius, Inter font family, and accordion keyframe animations, with typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing a YouTube-like video platform on Internet Computer with pending Stripe Premium Subscription integration tasks and notes on known build issues.
